UI_CookieSlicer_TipB_fps:
Pictures the game draws per second; more is smoother
30 or more plays comfortably
"lowest" = the worst moment in the last minute
UI_CookieSlicer_TipB_state:
Sums up FPS, RAM and the main thread
3 levels: Smooth / OK / Heavy
UI_CookieSlicer_Y_state_main: main thread almost full: "Smooth" on the right helps
UI_CookieSlicer_Y_state_ram_heap: game RAM almost full: more RAM with the button below
UI_CookieSlicer_Y_state_ram_pc: PC low on free RAM: close other programs
UI_CookieSlicer_Y_state_cpu: whole CPU busy: another program is using it
UI_CookieSlicer_Y_state_uifps: windows drawn more than needed: "Smooth" on the right helps
UI_CookieSlicer_Y_state_tune: the game can be lighter: see the right
UI_CookieSlicer_Y_state_other: see the settings on the right
UI_CookieSlicer_TipB_ram:
Memory the game uses / the most it may use
Above 85% the game has to clean up often:
stutter in a rhythm, or it closes
UI_CookieSlicer_Y_q_full: almost full: more RAM with the button below
UI_CookieSlicer_TipB_pcram:
Memory still free on the whole PC
Under 1.5 GB Windows uses the disk instead
and everything slows down; close Chrome or other programs
UI_CookieSlicer_Y_pcram_low: %1 GB free, too little: close other programs
UI_CookieSlicer_TipB_cpu:
All cores together
Zomboid is heavy on one core, so this can look low while the game stutters
Watch "Game main thread" instead
UI_CookieSlicer_Y_cpu_full: %1%, full: another program is using it
UI_CookieSlicer_TipT_main: What is the game main thread (most important)
UI_CookieSlicer_TipB_main:
The one core that runs the game and every mod
Above 90% the game waits = stutter
A faster PC helps little; less work (settings on the right) helps
UI_CookieSlicer_Y_main_full: %1%, almost full: "Smooth" on the right helps
UI_CookieSlicer_Y_noHelper: install the helper to see this number
UI_CookieSlicer_V_bad: Shader not available yet: use the basic looks on the right
UI_CookieSlicer_V_wait: That is all for now; the full check runs in game
